lead:
**ಲಿಬ್ರೆ ಕ್ಲೌಡ್** is my zero-trust self-hosted ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯ ಯೋಜನೆ running on Oracle Cloud's Always Free tier. The design routes all external traffic through Cloudflare for DDoS protection and IP masking, then into an Oracle Cloud VM running a Caddy reverse proxy that serves both public and WireGuard-private services.

ನಾನು ಇದನ್ನು 'Libre Cloud' ಎಂದು ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ಹೆಸರಿಸಿದೆ: everything in the stack is free and open source, the platform is free-tier cloud, ಮತ್ತು the domain carries the FOSS identity. It connects directly to my [[privacy-stack|Privacy Stack]] — services like Vaultwarden (passwords), Joplin Server (notes), ಮತ್ತು SearXNG (private search) are all designed to run here.

sections.title: ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ವಾಸ್ತವ — ನನ್ನ ಬಳಿ ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಏನಿದೆ

content.title: ಸ್ಥಿತಿ: ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಿತ / ತೀವ್ರವಾಗಿ ಸೀಮಿತ
content.content: My target VM was VM.Standard.A1.Flex — Oracle's 4 OCPU, 24 GB RAM ARM Ampere instance, free forever. I hit persistent 'out of capacity' errors in the Hyderabad region after repeated attempts over months. The ARM plan is abandoned for now. ನನ್ನ ಬಳಿ ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಇರುವುದು: 1x VM.Standard.E2.1.Micro — 1 OCPU, 1 GB RAM.

I designed the architecture so nothing is directly exposed to the internet without passing through Cloudflare and the reverse proxy layer. Services are split into three visibility tiers: public (accessible to anyone via Cloudflare), private (accessible only through a WireGuard VPN tunnel), ಮತ್ತು ARM-only (requiring the unprovisioned A1.Flex VM).

content.title: ನನ್ನ ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪ ಹರಿವು
content.content: Internet → Cloudflare (DNS + DDoS + IP masking) → Oracle Cloud VM (1 GB Micro) → Reverse proxy (Caddy/nginx) → [Public: Portfolio, Pi-hole DoH] / [Private (WireGuard-gated): Vaultwarden, Joplin Server, Gitea]

rows.ಉದ್ದೇಶ: Requires 24 GB RAM — indefinitely on hold

sections.title: ನಾನು Oracle Cloud ಅನ್ನು ಏಕೆ ಆರಿಸಿದೆ

content.content:
Oracle Cloud's Always Free tier is uniquely generous compared to AWS, GCP, ಮತ್ತು Azure free tiers. The headline offering is the **ARM Ampere A1.Flex** instance: 4 OCPU and 24 GB RAM — free forever. For comparison, AWS Free Tier gives a t2.micro (1 vCPU, 1 GB) for only 12 months. Oracle's AMD Micro is comparable but always-free in perpetuity, ಮತ್ತು the ARM Ampere would be dramatically more capable.

The catch is capacity availability: the Hyderabad region ARM Ampere has been perennially 'out of capacity'. This is a widely-reported issue in the Oracle Cloud community — not unique to me. Other regions would require a separate account setup. I've been stuck on this constraint for months.
ಯೋಜನೆ ಸದೃಢವಾಗಿದೆ. ಹಾರ್ಡ್‌ವೇರ್ ಮಾತ್ರ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಸಿಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
